name: data-governance
description: Product-neutral data governance for a data platform, built from an evidence-based study of governance tools (OpenMetadata 1.13.3, DataHub 1.7.0, Apache Atlas 2.5.0 as measured examples): data contracts and data products; catalog selection, lineage and impact analysis; classification, access control and masking; quality SLAs and incidents; KVKK (Turkish data protection law 6698) obligations mapped to platform controls; anonymisation (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, re-identification risk, ARX limits, documents); and a 14-domain / 90-capability assessment rubric with evidence discipline
